units.assessment: Can you list the immunophenotypic markers that define a T-follicular-helper phenotype, name the three nodal TFH entities recognised in the current classification, and state the recurrent mutations that cluster in this group?

lesson.note: Searched for teaching on angioimmunoblastic and other nodal TFH lymphomas. The pool returned general PTCL talks that never isolate the TFH entities, unrelated DLBCL and exam-mnemonic videos, and one French-language lecture. Nothing in English teaches the TFH immunophenotype (CD10, BCL6, PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS) or the TET2/DNMT3A/IDH2/RHOA mutation pattern, so the core slot is left open rather than filled with a generic PTCL overview.
